name: M7.FinalSelector.index_feasible
statement: ∀ (N w : ℕ) [NeZero N] (q : M7.DefaultQuery.Query), 0 < w → w ≤ N → M7.DefaultQuery.valid N q → ∀ x : M7.FinalSelector.Index N w q, M7.GlobalQuery.feasible q (M7.FinalSelector.family N w q) x ↔ M7.FinalSelector.RawFeasible w q (M7.FinalSelector.realize q x)
guidance: Actual family_good and PrefixOrbit.class_action give class validity of every realized index. QueryRebase.sector_base transports the base from family x.1 to act x.2(base); all other DefaultQuery.feasible fields already depend on identical literal placement. Preserve classSector/placementSector and NoLogical policies. Return tactic lines only, no leading by.
